## About this dashboard
Repeat dispensing is an important mechanism for managing long-term medication needs efficiently, reducing workload for prescribers and improving patient convenience. The Repeat Dispensing Cost Report in ePACT2 provides authorised users with detailed insights into the financial impact of repeat dispensing arrangements. It captures data on prescriptions issued under repeat dispensing schemes, including those processed electronically via EPS, and calculates associated costs based on Net Ingredient Cost (NIC).

This report enables practices, SICBLs, and commissioners to monitor monthly and cumulative expenditure on repeat dispensing items. Users can filter data by time period and organisation, supporting targeted analysis and benchmarking against regional and national averages. The report also helps identify trends in repeat dispensing utilisation, which can inform medicines optimisation strategies and financial planning.

The aim of this report is to promote transparency and accountability in repeat dispensing costs. It helps organisations assess whether repeat dispensing is being used appropriately and whether cost variations are clinically justified. While the report provides valuable financial insights, it should be used alongside other prescribing dashboards to ensure that efficiency measures do not compromise patient safety. Its intention is to support discussions within local health economies, inform improvement initiatives, and reduce unwarranted variation in prescribing practices.
